messages.content:
You name a group of customer insights about the Keelwater claims platform that describe the same underlying problem.

Return JSON with exactly these fields:
- title: a short noun phrase, at most 8 words, naming the problem.
- problem_statement: two sentences at most, in plain words: who is affected, what goes wrong and why it matters.

Use only the problems and quotes given. Name no customer or person. Do not mention ARR or counts.

- problem: The reporting team cannot complete month-end close because reserve data hasn't updated.
  quote: Our reporting team’s been waiting on those reserves ... it’s holding up the month‑end close.
- problem: The reserves report they try to retrieve shows outdated data despite re-syncing integrations.
  quote: we’re having trouble pulling the latest reserves report for our policyholders. It’s showing outdated figures even after we re-synced the integrations.
- problem: Reserves are not updating in the reporting tab even after reprocessing documents.
  quote: The claim reference is A17-MAR-0089. We’ve already reprocessed the documents twice but the reserves still aren’t updating in the reporting tab.
- problem: Payments remain pending and claim reserves do not update after submitting commercial property claims.
  quote: It’s mostly the commercial property claims under policyholder ID C8821 — the ones we submitted last Tuesday. The payments show as pending but reserves aren’t updating.
- problem: The user cannot retrieve the latest payments report, delaying month‑end close.
  quote: we’re having trouble pulling the latest payments report for our policyholders, and it’s holding up our month-end close.
- problem: The user cannot pull the latest reserves report for a high‑value marine claim, delaying payments.
  quote: we’re having trouble pulling the latest reserves report for a high-value marine claim, and it’s holding up our payment cycle.
- problem: They cannot retrieve the latest reserve amounts for high-value claims.
  quote: we’re having trouble pulling updated reserves for our high-value claims this morning
- problem: A claim has been stuck in reserves for over a week without payment processing.
  quote: I’ve got a claim for a policyholder that’s been sitting in reserves ... can you check if the payment ... is queued?
